In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
continuous extrusion is an effective method to refine the grain size of the aluminum alloys,and it is a good way to improve the mechanical properties.
the grain size is smaller and the mechanical properties of the alloy are better when the alloy is processed by multi-pass continuous extrusion.
the multi-pass continuous extrusion can effectively refine the grains of 3003 alloy and improve the mechanical properties,but the grain growth occurs during the following annealing process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the multi-pass continuous extrusion process can effectively improve the mechanical properties of 3003 alloy,and the following annealing process is necessary to refine the microstructure.

continuous extrusion processing is a promising technology for the grain refinement and the improvement of mechanical properties of the aluminum alloy,and it is also an effective way to improve the quality of aluminum alloy products.

the grain size and the properties of the 3003 aluminum alloys can be effectively improved by the continuous extrusion process,and the annealing temperature is a key factor to control the grain size of the alloy.

the grain size and the mechanical properties of 3003 alloy are greatly improved after continuous extrusion processing,while more extrusion passes may lead to coarsening of the recrystallizing grains in the annealing treatment.
